rules.description: Parse with the verified delimiter/encoding and validate every column type, range, and category against the dataset contract. Fail closed on any fatal issue; never coerce or clip.
rules.name: parse_and_validate

rules.description: Rename source headers to snake_case by the fixed mapping.
rules.name: normalize_column_names

rules.description: Full-row duplicates are rejected, never silently dropped.
rules.name: reject_full_row_duplicates

rules.description: Sort by (year, month, day, session_id, order) ascending, stably. Defines click order regardless of on-disk row order.
rules.name: canonical_sort

rules.description: Emit the fixed output column order (schema + session_key).
rules.name: order_output_columns
